claim_en: ISRAEL DWELT IN SHITTIM — THE TABERNACLE'S TIMBER; THE PEOPLE BEGAN — NOAH'S VERB, THREE VERBS IN ONE SKIN; THE SPEC OF EXODUS 34:15-16 AND ITS RUN — THE FEMININE 'THEIR GODS' AT BOTH ALONE; THE SIFREI'S SITTING EXEMPLARS MEASURED; SITTING AS SUBVERSION, THE MARKETS, THE WINE NOT YET FORBIDDEN, PEOR'S WORSHIP BY BARING. 'And Israel dwelt in SHITTIM' (25:1, one seat) — the last camp (33:49 Abel-shittim), Joshua's spies sent 'from Shittim' (2:1), Micah's 'from Shittim to Gilgal' (6:5); the name is 'ACACIA (shittim) wood', the tabernacle's timber twenty-six times in Exodus and the ark's (Deut 10:3) (computed); 'and the people BEGAN to whore after the daughters of Moab' — 'and the people began' one seat; the token's Torah four are three verbs in one skin: Noah 'BEGAN' the vineyard (Gen 9:20), Noah 'WAITED' for the dove (8:10), Moses 'ENTREATED' after the calf (Exod 32:11), and this (computed); THE SPEC AND ITS RUN: Exod 34:15-16 'lest... they whore after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and call you and you eat of their sacrifice, and you take of their DAUGHTERS, and their daughters whore after THEIR gods' — 25:1-2 runs it clause by clause: the daughters of Moab, the whoring, 'they CALLED the people to the SACRIFICES of their gods, and the people ATE and bowed' (25:2), and the FEMININE plural 'their gods' (the daughters' gods) stands in the Bible at the spec (34:16) and the run (25:2) alone (computed); the Sifrei reads 'sitting' as subversion on two exemplars measured on the ink — the calf's 'the people sat to eat and drink' (Exod 32:6) and the brothers' 'they sat to eat bread' (Gen 37:25) (131:1); its Shittim story: the markets from Beth-jeshimoth to the Mount of Snow, the harlot's third day, the pitcher of Ammonite wine 'NOT YET FORBIDDEN to Israelites' (a dating datum for the decree on gentile wine), the image of Peor — 'bare yourself before him': THE SAGES RULED THAT BARING ONESELF TO PEOR IS ITS WORSHIP (Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6 the answer sheet); the three anecdotes of the gentiles' own scorn of the rite (131:2). Onkelos: 'to whore' → to STRAY; 'their gods' → their ERRORS (cut).
middah: M-22 (the run-teaches-spec family — Exodus 34:15-16 the spec, 25:1-2 its run, the feminine 'their gods' at the two seats alone; the Sifrei's exemplars measured)

'And Israel YOKED itself to Baal-peor' (25:3) — the verb's three seats in the Bible (25:3, 25:5 'the yoked ones', Ps 106:28 'they yoked themselves to Baal-peor and ate sacrifices of the dead'); its noun is 19:15's LID, 'tzamid patil', and Rebekah's BRACELETS (Gen 24:22) — the Sifrei's allusion at the heifer (126:1, sitting 6) is now the ink's own: the fastened lid and the fastened people; Baal-peor the god of Balaam's third stand (23:28) (computed on the points); 'and the anger of the LORD burned against Israel' — the portion's THIRD anger (22:22, 24:10, 25:3), Moses' 32:13-14 retelling it; 'and the LORD said to Moses' (25:4) — THE FIRST frame to Moses in the portion after nine approaches to Balaam; 'take all the heads of the people and HANG them to the LORD BEFORE THE SUN' — the hang-verb's other seats are Saul's seven sons 'hanged to the LORD' at Gibeah (2 Sam 21:6, 9, 13), the same verb and the same 'to the LORD'; Jacob's hip 'was WRENCHED' (Gen 32:26) its consonantal kin; 'before the sun' one seat, David's sentence 'before all Israel and before the sun' (2 Sam 12:12); 'the burning anger of the LORD' here and at 32:14 (computed); ONKELOS 'take the heads of the people and JUDGE AND KILL whoever deserves death' — the court written into the verse: the heads are the judges, the hanged the guilty (the exam's Sanhedrin 35a; the Sifrei 131:2 reads it so, 'slay each his TWO men') (cut); 'Moses said to THE JUDGES OF ISRAEL' (25:5) — the noun's first seat as an office (Deut 16:18, 19:18 follow); Jethro's chiefs (Exod 18:21) the exam's count; 'slay each his men who were YOKED to Baal-peor' — one seat (computed).
